#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Atomic HTTP/3 -> HTTP/1.1 translation bridge (offline synthetic fixtures).

Reads one JSON scenario on stdin, writes one JSON audit ledger on stdout.
Field strings and ledger strings denote Latin-1 octets (U+0000..U+00FF).
"""

import ipaddress
import json
import re
import sys

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# deployment policy tables
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

METHODS = frozenset((b"GET", b"HEAD", b"POST", b"PUT", b"PATCH", b"DELETE",
                     b"OPTIONS"))
SCHEMES = frozenset((b"http", b"https"))
DEFAULT_PORT = {"http": 80, "https": 443}

# initial regular fields that may never appear
PROHIBITED = frozenset((
    b"connection", b"proxy-connection", b"keep-alive", b"transfer-encoding",
    b"upgrade", b"http2-settings", b"trailer"))

# initial regular fields that may repeat as separate lines
REPEATABLE = frozenset((
    b"accept", b"accept-encoding", b"cache-control", b"if-match",
    b"if-none-match", b"pragma", b"vary"))

PSEUDO = frozenset((b":method", b":scheme", b":authority", b":path"))

MAX_SECTION_SIZE = 8192
MAX_CONTENT = 65536

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# octet-shaped grammar
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------

NAME_RE = re.compile(rb"[a-z0-9!#$%&'*+\-.^_`|~]+\Z")
VALUE_RE = re.compile(rb"[\x21-\x7e\x80-\xff]"
                      rb"(?:[\t\x20\x21-\x7e\x80-\xff]*[\x21-\x7e\x80-\xff])?\Z")
PATH_RE = re.compile(rb"/(?:[a-zA-Z0-9\-._~!$&'()*+,;=:@/?]|%[0-9a-fA-F]{2})*\Z")
DNS_LABEL_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9a-zA-Z](?:[0-9a-zA-Z-]{0,61}[0-9a-zA-Z])?\Z")
PORT_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9]{1,5}\Z")
CL_MEMBER_RE = re.compile(rb"[0-9]+\Z")


def name_ok(name):
    """Regular field name: nonempty, lowercase letters/digits/punctuation."""
    if not name:
        return False
    return NAME_RE.match(name) is not None


def value_ok(value):
    """Empty, or visible-octet edges with SP/HTAB allowed only inside."""
    if not value:
        return True
